mhF3BkzlTaGiLzJ7kvpmVc:9553-131170.notes: Verified 2026-08-05 (56 unstamped frames rendered + compared): the mobile/tablet IA is REAL and armed on viewport alone (Spot.tsx:113-114 dropped the REDESIGN_TRADE_MOBILE gate), and desktop 8687-99711 plus 41 mobile/tablet frames match element for element. BUILT 2026-08-05, 4 of the 13 named gaps: (1) the priced quick-trade bar with the inline lot-sized stepper (8666-109490 / 8684-162077 / 8666-108146) ships as MobileBuySellBar's `quickTrade` variant, printing the live best ask on Buy and best bid on Sell from useOrderbook, with one press of +/- = the market's own lotSize (base unit) or that lot priced at the mark (quote unit) - no invented step constant; the amount + unit seed the ticket the bar opens (new OrderEntryPanel initialSide/initialSizeInput/initialSizeUnit props, which also fixed Sell opening a Buy ticket). *** TWO Figma bars exist for one surface: 9770-134779 / 9002-158176 draw plain Buy/Sell. Both ship - the priced bar renders only when the book has a real bid AND ask, so an offline or empty book falls back to exactly the plain frames rather than printing a price we do not hold. Verified live at 375: with no local book, the plain bar renders. (2) the 375 two-pane order book + inline ticket (8684-162456) ships behind the shell's new `allowSplitView` toggle, rendered and screenshot-verified at 375 (tab row collapses to Order book|Trades, left pane book, right pane ticket, no bottom bar). The toggle sits at the right END OF THE TAB ROW, not inside the market-header card as drawn: MarketHeader is shared with the desktop grid and the perp terminal and has no mobile treatment yet. DECLINED, needs a source: the Net-profit P&L chart series (8650-94501 / 8684-166194 / 8650-94724 / 8684-166395 / 8687-102751 / 8626-85537 / 8626-131650). TradingChart is the free TradingView embed with no series API, and NO spot P&L time series exists - /api/perp/pnl/:address is perps-only and returns scalars plus position lists, and deriving a curve from partial spot order history would print money numbers that can be wrong. DECLINED, IA conflict for Casey: the full-scroll composites 8931-65660 / 8931-64499 draw ONE 1870px scroll with SpotInfoSections inline, a different IA from the viewport-locked tabbed shell that shipped and that 41 frames were verified against. Only one can render; that is a design call, not a build gap. NOTE: 6 frames the registry lists as `desktop` are 375 or 768 in Figma (8558-139280, 8570-143200, 8626-61565 = 768; 8626-85537, 8626-131650, 8626-130555 = 375).

10509-18308.title: Skai > Predict - full (375x812px)
10509-18308.notes: Full-scroll root at mobile (10509-18308) and tablet (10642-185390): search row, horizontally scrolling category nav, single-column card list, "Show more markets", then an FAQ accordion. TWO OF THE THREE GAPS CLOSED 2026-08-05. (1) The FAQ block now renders on the root as src/components/predict/PredictFaq.tsx — the detail-page FaqPanel could not be reused because buildFaq() is market-scoped and there is no market in scope on the root, so this is a platform-level accordion with the frame's four questions. (2) The multi-date grouped card is built as src/components/predict/GroupedMarketCard.tsx over src/lib/predict/eventGroups.ts, which folds sibling markets that differ only by a trailing deadline into one card; every row still shows its own market's real price and trades through its own venue modal, and the match rule is deliberately strict (same venue, same category, stem ≥20 chars, 2–6 rows) so unrelated markets are never presented as one event. STILL OPEN: the two-team three-odds sports card — DECLINED, not deferred, because no SKAI venue is 3-outcome and the DRAW button would have to carry an invented price. ★ As of 2026-08-05 that decline is the ONLY item left on this family: no buildable gap remains. The footer question was settled by reading the layer tree — 10509-18308 runs Show more markets -> FAQ -> Bottom-navigation-mobile at y=1730 and draws NO footer, unlike the 1440 cut. PredictPage renders SiteFooter at every width regardless, recorded as an accepted divergence (every other content screen ships it at all widths, and the shell's pb-(52px+safe-area) below lg keeps it clear of the bottom nav). Held at `partial` rather than flipped to `done` on purpose: the frame contains an element that cannot be built truthfully, and calling the family done would erase that.

PAGE FOOTER CLOSED 2026-08-05 — the full-scroll desktop frame 8610-163972 ends on a short Skai wordmark over Home/Help/Terms/Privacy (nodes 8610:164927-164930) and that is exactly SiteFooter, already shipped on Portfolio/Screener/Upgrade/Launch-live/legal, whose four links all resolve to real routes; it now renders after PredictFaq. 10642-185390.title: Skai > Predict - full (768 x 1024px)
10642-185390.notes: Full-scroll root at mobile (10509-18308) and tablet (10642-185390): search row, horizontally scrolling category nav, single-column card list, "Show more markets", then an FAQ accordion. TWO OF THE THREE GAPS CLOSED 2026-08-05. (1) The FAQ block now renders on the root as src/components/predict/PredictFaq.tsx — the detail-page FaqPanel could not be reused because buildFaq() is market-scoped and there is no market in scope on the root, so this is a platform-level accordion with the frame's four questions. (2) The multi-date grouped card is built as src/components/predict/GroupedMarketCard.tsx over src/lib/predict/eventGroups.ts, which folds sibling markets that differ only by a trailing deadline into one card; every row still shows its own market's real price and trades through its own venue modal, and the match rule is deliberately strict (same venue, same category, stem ≥20 chars, 2–6 rows) so unrelated markets are never presented as one event. STILL OPEN: the two-team three-odds sports card — DECLINED, not deferred, because no SKAI venue is 3-outcome and the DRAW button would have to carry an invented price. ★ As of 2026-08-05 that decline is the ONLY item left on this family: no buildable gap remains. The footer question was settled by reading the layer tree — 10509-18308 runs Show more markets -> FAQ -> Bottom-navigation-mobile at y=1730 and draws NO footer, unlike the 1440 cut. PredictPage renders SiteFooter at every width regardless, recorded as an accepted divergence (every other content screen ships it at all widths, and the shell's pb-(52px+safe-area) below lg keeps it clear of the bottom nav). Held at `partial` rather than flipped to `done` on purpose: the frame contains an element that cannot be built truthfully, and calling the family done would erase that.

10640-28003.title: Skai > Predict > Rewards (375x812px)
10640-28003.notes: Structure shipped + real market list/prices/SKAI-points. THE 375/768 REGRESSION IS FIXED 2026-08-05. RewardsMarketTable used to reach small screens by HIDING cells - Min. Shares and Competitiveness below lg, Reward and Earnings below md - so a phone lost all four of the figures this screen is built around, silently, with no heading and no reason left behind. That is strictly worse than the honest em dash those cells carry, because an absent row reads as 'this screen has nothing to say' rather than 'this number has no source yet'. The row is now ONE DOM structure that restyles: a two-column stacked card below lg where every figure carries its own inline label, snapping to the frame's seven-column table at lg where the header strip returns. Two rendered copies behind lg:hidden / hidden lg:block was rejected - it duplicates every question, price and link in the a11y tree. Pinned by 4 new tests in tests/pages/predict/PredictRewards.test.tsx (labels present and not bare-hidden, no md:block/lg:block anywhere in a row, prices survive, header strip is lg-only). STILL PARTIAL: the rewards-program figures themselves (daily rewards, this month, min shares, competitiveness, reward, earnings) remain honest em dashes because no accrual backend exists; and the mobile frame's All/Elections/Primaries/Sports/Oscars chip row (OutcomeMarket has no category field), its All time-period select, its Open positions / Mergeable toggles, and the card '+' affordance (nothing in the repo defines what it adds) are not built.

10539-46305.title: Skai > Predict > Breaking (375x812px)
10539-46305.notes: Mobile (10539-46305, 10545-47421) and tablet (10654-197572, 10710-132119) stack four blocks: a hero card, a numbered 1-15 movers list (question + chance + delta), a 'Get daily updates' email-capture card, and a 'Live from @skai.predict' timestamped signals feed. TWO of the four now have implementations. The hero is PredictHero rendering its honest no-featured-market shell. The movers list is BUILT 2026-08-05 - PredictInsightsPanel renders a real ranked MoverRow list off signedProbabilityMoveBps over the priorProbability join - and falls back to its stated-empty panel only because outcome_trades holds zero rows, which is a measurement rather than a hardcoded impossibility. THE OTHER TWO ARE NOW DECLINES, NOT BACKLOG — investigated 2026-08-05 and neither can ship honestly. The 'Get daily updates' email-capture card: `waitlist_emails` exists but it is the skai.trade LANDING waitlist synced to Customer.io, and there is no predict daily-digest sender anywhere in src or supabase/functions, so the card would take an address against a mail that will never be sent — or quietly enrol the user in an unrelated list. The 'Live from @skai.predict' signals feed: that handle does not exist. grep across src, modules/skai-bot and supabase returns zero hits for `skai.predict`, and the only official accounts the codebase knows are instagram.com/skai.trade and x.com/SkaiTrade. A feed 'live from' an account nobody owns can only be fabricated. Recorded as declines so they stop reading as unstarted work; the family stays partial because the movers list is measured-empty (outcome_trades zero-row), which is data, not code.

Traced every blackjack_* key from its write site to its read site: 9 of 12 are read by nothing that affects an outcome. The rules are hard-coded independently in all THREE settlement paths - points-game/index.ts:2683 hits soft 17 unconditionally (under a comment calling it "the fixed rule"), game-settlement/index.ts:8881 reads BJ_CONFIG.dealerHitsSoft17 which is a module-level `const true` at :7577 never assigned from the DB, and 20260326_blackjack_hmac_shuffle.sql:269-270 does the same in SQL. DEAD KEYS, no read site outside the admin form: blackjack_dealer_hits_soft17, blackjack_allow_surrender, blackjack_payout_ratio, blackjack_insurance_payout, blackjack_deck_count, blackjack_suited_bj_multiplier, blackjack_suited_777_multiplier. DISPLAY-ONLY: blackjack_allow_double_after_split and blackjack_max_split_hands reach exactly two render sites (BlackjackGame.tsx:3611, :3615) - so toggling them changed the rules TEXT the player reads while the enforced caps stayed put, i.e. it made the game lie rather than deal differently. GENUINELY LIVE: only blackjack_enabled / _min_bet / _max_bet, and those are bypassed on POINTS anyway (BlackjackGame.tsx:681-682 hard-codes 1/1000). The sharpest edge was AdminJackpotConfig.tsx:263-277, a savable "Standard Blackjack Payout" input with helper text "1.5 = 3:2, 1.2 = 6:5": setting 6:5 there would have read back as a cut to the player's return while every engine kept paying 3:2. It also directly contradicted BlackjackConfigCard.tsx:158, which declares the payout fixed at 3:2 - and the engines side with the card. DECISION: made read-only, NOT wired, and reported rather than quietly reconciled. Both surfaces now render the enforced value with the engine file:line beside it and an amber note saying changes here would not change a hand dealt; the two suited-side-bet multipliers read "not implemented" because no engine deals a suited side bet at all. Controls kept visible rather than deleted so the intent survives for whoever wires it. ★ 2026-08-05 THE ADMIN CONFIG SURFACE IS NOW HONEST END TO END - BlackjackConfigCard was only half the problem. AdminJackpotConfig.tsx still shipped THREE live liars after the Blackjack Payouts card was made read-only. (a) The 'Configuration Impact' preview went on MULTIPLYING the very keys that card had just declared dead, quoting exact SKAI figures for prizes that do not exist: 'Suited BJ Payout (10 SKAI bet) 250 SKAI', 'Suited 777 Payout 1000 SKAI', 'Hi-Lo Exact Guess 777 SKAI' and 'Jackpot Contribution (1000 SKAI bet) 10.00 SKAI'. All four rows are gone. VERDICT ON WIRE-vs-READ-ONLY: read-only, deliberately. Wiring means threading config reads into three independent settlement engines (points-game, game-settlement and the SQL settle path), and blackjackGameService.ts:1179-1198 already documents rules-come-from-the-rail as a decision rather than an oversight. Making the panel match the engines is a UI change; making the engines match the panel is not. ★★★ 2026-08-05 CLOSED. M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:9003-79079.title: Skai > Play > Casino > Plinko (1440 x 900px)
M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:9003-79079.notes: ★ 2026-08-05: the four board/panel defects recorded on 2026-08-05 are FIXED IN SOURCE against the frames; still `partial` because nothing was render-measured and the tablet/mobile tier is unbuilt. WHAT WAS FIXED. (1) PER-DIFFICULTY PALETTE. PlinkoGame.tsx now carries three ramps in PLINKO_BUCKET_RAMPS, each sampled bucket-by-bucket off its own frame: Easy (low) #90E3E7 #7DD4E7 #69C6E6 #57B8E6 #46ACE6 #349EE6 #2391E6 #1184E6 #0078E6 from 9069:6513; Medium #A1E03C #8ED639 #7ACD37 #67C334 #55BB31 #44B12F #34A72C #34A72C #1A9627 from 9095:5889; Hard (high) #E590F2 #DB85EE #D17CEB #C771E7 #BE68E3 #B45EE0 #AA55DC #A04CD9 #9744D5 from 9095:5332. Previously ONE ramp - the Easy one - was hardcoded and painted on all three, so Medium and Hard rendered the wrong colourway outright. (2) THE RAMP IS MIRRORED. Each array runs EDGE->CENTRE and getMultiplierSlotColor indexes it by distance from the centre bucket, so the row is symmetric exactly as all three frames draw it. The old getMultiplierSlotColors mapped t = index/(total-1) monotonically and colour-inverted the right half of every board; the comment asserting the frame was "NOT a symmetric center-out ramp" was itself the bug and is replaced - those nine stops were precisely the nine distinct colours of the mirrored HALF row. Resampling still works for the 8- and 12-row boards. Bucket chrome now matches too: flat fill instead of a vertical gradient, radius/border/foot held as the frame's ratios (4.565, 1.712 and 13.55 over 31.952 of slot height), inset bottom foot at rgba(0,0,0,0.2), the white 15% top highlight dropped (the frame has none), and text pinned to Green Coal 300 #001615 on every bucket rather than luminance-picked. (3) THREE BALL VARIANTS BUILT. 9137-10213/10215/10217 are flat 10px discs - confirmed from the exported SVGs, `<circle r="5">` with a single fill - at #56C7F3 Easy, #3BFF00 Medium, #DC4CE9 Hard. drawGame drew one r=7 orange-red radial gradient with a 14px glow and a white specular for all three; it now draws a flat r=5 disc keyed off riskLevel. Ball hues are NOT the bucket hues (the balls are more saturated), so they live in their own PLINKO_BALL_COLOR map. (4) AUTO PANEL. Label is the frame's "Number of Bets:", the field accepts 0, an infinity affordance sits at its trailing edge where the frame's 16x7 glyph is, and 0 now genuinely means unlimited - burstDrop runs to POSITIVE_INFINITY, placing one REAL playPlinko settlement per ball until stopped. The 25-ball cap is now understood as a RENDER budget: long and unlimited runs WAIT for headroom per tick instead of being trimmed, so the "Burst Trimmed" toast is gone. CTA relabelled "Bet" per 9104:6251. (5) PEGS, found while verifying the above and fixed with it. The peg SVGs export byte-identical from the Easy and Medium frames (9069:5872 vs 9095:5373), so pegs are NOT per-difficulty - the board's risk colour is carried entirely by the buckets and the ball. The frame draws a FLAT WHITE circle, r=3.42339 on a 34.234 column pitch, i.e. exactly 0.1 of the pitch.
